artBrief: **Cozy French cafe.** A familiar corner table and an open appointment book under a hanging lamp. No clock hands implying a required lesson time.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Cozy French cafe. A familiar corner table and an open appointment book under a hanging lamp. No clock hands implying a required lesson time. An intimate empty cafe corner, round wooden table, large open appointment book with blank pages and a hanging amber lamp. Sage wall and terracotta upholstery, inviting evening glow.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
